verdicts.reason: A: the 'See the Schedule' button is jammed into the bottom-left corner, clipped by the canvas edge, and sits on top of the fine print, which is cut off ('...the café go to the local library fund'). The card also fills almost the whole canvas, so the confetti framing is lost. B: the book on the confetti beside a headline card reads well as a banner, and the CTA and fine print are grouped cleanly. Its flaws: the Inkwell & Lantern logo has shrunk to near-illegible size, the card runs tight to the right and top edges, and the book floats a little low with an uneven left margin.
